title: The Earliest Moment When Everyone Become Friends
description: Find the earliest time when all n people are connected in a social network using Disjoint Set Union (DSU).
pseudocode:
1: sort logs by timestamp
2: parent = [0, 1, 2]
3: count = 3
4: for log in logs:
5:   rootA = find(log.u)
6:   rootB = find(log.v)
7:   if rootA != rootB:
8:     union(rootA, rootB)
9:     count--
10:    if count == 1: return log.timestamp

steps.note: Process log [0, 1, 2]: find root of 0 and 1
Union 0 and 1; person 0 now points to 1
Decrement count of disjoint sets to 2
Process log [1, 0, 2]: find root of 0 and 2
Union 0 and 2; person 1 now points to 2
Decrement count of disjoint sets to 1
Count is 1, return the current timestamp
